notes.title: Hotfix September 9th
notes.content:
Small update to fix two bugs related to yesterday's public beta update.

- Departures not being removed from departures list.

- Scrollbar covering the status color.

notes.title: Manual Status Mode - Update Notes September 8th
notes.content:
This update for the public beta brings a manual mode for the status codes in the flight list. In this mode the controller has full control over the status and can also change the color marking on the right side in the list. There are a few preset status codes but it is also possible to write.



Some more aircraft icons and callsigns has also been added. If you have requested a callsign but it was not added the request might have been missing the callsign (only ICAO code is no longer allowed) or the request might have been for an airline that is no longer active. Feel free to resubmit a request if it was missing the callsign. The callsign requirement was added to reduce the amount of game development time used for handling airline requests.



Also, a new option has been added for how far ahead of the slot time pilots call for pushback.



- Fixed departure events not activating.

- Added a points log to the finish screen.

- Changed rule for spawning airplanes. The game will still try to spawn unique flights but if all flights are in use it will now spawn a random flight from the airport’s flights list.

- (Builder) Fixed issues with storage setting not updating correctly.

- (Builder) Added shortcut for changing one way setting for line.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Taxi speed change and fixes - Update Notes September 2nd
notes.content:
Update to public beta mainly to fix issues with multiple aircraft spawning at the same time. Also based on feedback regarding taxi speed, taxi speed has been lowered.



- Lowered taxi speed.

- Reduced time needed to detach pushback tug.

- Fixed the filter for which stands should be available to change to depending on the tow being to or from storage.

- Fixed multiple airplanes spawning at once.

- Added button and shortcut to repeat last message from pilot.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Fixes and stand possibility to change stands - Update Notes August 28th
notes.content:
Many fixes in this update for the public beta version. Also adds a new option to change the stand for an aircraft (for arrivals and towing operations).

 

- Fixed runway still being marked as in use even after last aircraft assigned to it was switched to another runway.

- Fixed incorrect runway pairs in runway config window.

- Fixed running out of flights on longer sessions.

- Fixed double punctuation on points message.

- Fixed bug when setting a spawn rate to zero during the session.

- Fixed parked aircraft blocking taxing aircraft.

- Fixed incorrect delay points deduction when towing.

- Fixed issues with non-pushback stands at RJBB.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Separated spawn rates and new runway config window - Update Notes August 22nd
notes.content:
This update for the public beta makes it possible to set different spawn rates for arrivals, departures and towing operations. Also, it allows to completely stop any of the three by setting the spawn rate to zero. The session settings have changed format so your session settings will most likely be reset to default.



Also, towing is now going to and from stands marked as “Can be used for storage”. This is a new setting in the airport builder. If there are no stands marked for storage in the airport any stand can be used for storage. When an aircraft is moved to storage the stand tag does not matter. However, when taken out of storage for departure the stand tag matters.



The runways in the runway config window will now be generated automatically based on the spawn points in the layout (technically it is the points connected to the spawn point as that is most likely the end of the runway). To avoid the risk of overlapping buttons the buttons have been moved below the map.



Other things in this update:

- Messages from pilot, points updates and errors are now displayed in the bottom right corner.

- One more row available for airplane tag.

- If callsign not found letters will be spelled out.

- More callsigns added.



There has also been some cleaning in the codebase which does not effect the gameplay but is important for future development as clean code is easier to make changes to. 



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Small fixes and workshop out of beta – Update Notes August 12th
notes.content:
This update is mainly to bring the default version up to the latest version. This includes access to workshop airports. The airport builder is stable but will be kept in beta a bit longer, mainly due to a lack of documentation or guide.

There are also two smaller fixes from the latest beta version. Holding points no longer need to have exactly two connected lines. Now it is two lines connected minimum, but more connections are allowed. An issue with the toggle for auto arrival rate not showing a value has been fixed.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Customizable Airplane Radar Tags - Update Notes August 8th
notes.content:
Lots of things done this week for the public beta. Options for tags and pilot readbacks and improved runway logic. If this version is stable the default version will also be moved to this version giving the default version access to the workshop however the airport builder will still be beta.



The airplane tag can now be formatted via the radar settings page in game. Choose which data you want visible on the tag and where on the tag the data should be. It is also possible to toggle the background of the tag.



Additional settings have been added to the pilot readbacks. It is now its own page in the in-game menu. The volume for pilot does not transfer to the new system so this will have to be set during first session.



Also there has been issues with holding points that are close to other holding points, usually due to runways being close to each other. This should now be handled better and resolve issues like aircraft not entering runway or entering runway without handoff. However, it is still recommended to try to keep a good distance between holding points to avoid players accidentally selecting the wrong one.



Game

- Four more view slots added.

- Improved path following on curves.

- Fixed issue with arrivals and departures not alternating when queue at runway.

- Fixed long airport names overflowing in airport list.

- Fixed issue with tag blocking path setting.

- Fixed double handoff needed message in pop-up menu.

- Improved visibility of assigned stand and runway entry / exit point.



Builder

- Added shortcut to split line (T).

- Two more aircraft icons added.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Changes to UI design and Aircraft Icons - Update Notes August 1st
notes.content:
In addition to various updates both the game and builder this public beta update also brings changes to the UI. The previously used font is back and the design is more compact. Designing the UI is a complex task as the goal is a design that is inviting to aviation interested players, causal players and new players. Feedback is welcome.

Another visual change is the option for different icons for different aircraft types. This can be enabled via the radar settings (aircraft mode 2). Also, the size of the icon is scaled based on real life size however this might have to change slightly as the smallest airplanes are barely visible.

Game

- Improved aircraft movement in queues.

- Stand number added to taxi readbacks.

- Fixed bug with airplane not crossing runway.

- Audio added for over 100 callsigns.

 

Builder

- Additional airplane model icons added.

- Fixed bug with incorrect icon showing and hiding icon if input set to -1.

- Expanded shape group range to 1 to 199 for ground and 200 to 499 for buildings.

- Fixed bug with line type showing question mark.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix July 26th
notes.content: Small update to fix issue in builder with stands with the default "ANY" tag.

notes.title: Updates to Builder - Update Notes July 25th
notes.content:
This update brings changes to the builder. The main change for this update is a fix to resolve issues with missing lines and moved waypoints when loading an airport file. Unfortunately, current files with this issue cannot be repaired automatically.

Other updates:

- Added notice for runway missing runway label.

- Added notice for runway label for direction without spawn point.

- Changes to the loading of shapes to slightly improve loading speed.

- Clear screen button added.

- Added an option for which aircraft icon to show when selecting a stand waypoint.

- Added information about which aircraft model each icon is based on. Note that the icon can be used for other aircraft models. For example, the model for A320 can also be used for A319.

- Added icons based on Boeing 757-200 and Airbus A340-300.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: General Improvements - Update Notes July 19th
notes.content:
This update brings general improvements and also some new callsigns that has been requested for community made airports. It also brings the default version to the latest version but without the workshop and builder. Select the publicbeta to access the workshop and builder. It has been a lot of progress this week. Next week I have other commitments so expect a slower pace.

Game

Bug related to default entry and exit points fixed.

Runway layout window bug fixed.

Departures at start has been limited to maximum 80% of the airport’s capacity (number of stands).

Scroll bug in workshop airport list fixed. (Only beta version)

Highscore saved for workshop and local airports. (Only beta version)

For default version also some improvements added in previous beta versions.

Builder (Only beta version)

When changing screens builder will prompt to load the same file as on previous screen.

Runway segments are no longer needed and has been removed.

The test airport is now readonly. The code TEST cannot be saved to.

Warning for no spawn points for runway direction added.

One way visibility toggle bug fixed.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Changes to Airport File Format - Update Notes July 16th
notes.content:
The new runway logic seems to be heading in the right direction. This update has some runway bugs fixed but is mainly about two changes in the airport file format. The rest of this post goes into detail about the changes to the airport file format however, this type of media is not the best for explaining so you have any questions feel free to write them in the comments.



Stand tag

Stands now have one singular tag instead of individual tags for flight type, aircraft type, airlines and so on. This tag is also added to flights to control where airplanes go. The new system might take some time to understand but will allow for more flexibility in the long run. Also, it removes the need for an aircraft model database (an airline database is still needed for audio reasons).



Runway segments

A nice thing with the new runway logic is that I was able to remove the need for runway segments. There is however a small change to runway speed points. These can now also be cross points. A cross point is needed when a holding point is for a path that only crosses the runway and does not connect to it. A notice will be displayed when trying to save if a cross point is needed.

notes.title: Runway Logic Overhaul – Update Notes July 14th
notes.content:
The beta branch has been updated with an overhauled runway logic. If the changes lead to a better gameplay experience, the default version of the game will also be changed to this version but without the workshop and builder as these are still in beta testing.

Some smaller changes also worth highlighting in this update:

Fixed a bug that caused centerline not being visible at some airports.

Added a delete all shape points with the same group number button to the builder.

Added a tip to select runways to start session.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Starting Workshop beta - Update Notes July 10th
notes.content:
The work on the builder has been progressing nicely (most of the time) and the beta version of the game now also contain the builder. It was deemed that a combined solution was better than a separate DLC. For players on the beta version there will now be options as you press play in steam, only use the ones ending in BETA.



The workshop has been activated and the beta version of the builder can upload airports to the workshop and the beta version of the game can load airports that the player has subscribed to.



While focus has been on the builder there are also some fixes and improvements to the game:

Added button to reset session settings to default settings.

Last used runway configuration for each airport is now saved between sessions.

Push back now has a starting phase of 10 to 20 seconds before starting to move.

If there is a queue with both landings and takeoffs at a runway the tower will now alternate between landings and takeoffs. (Previously, takeoffs were unintentionally prioritized because they can lineup).



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Starting testing of airport builder - Update Notes June 27th
notes.content:
The work with the airport builder is moving forward and for testing the beta branch is not able to load additional airports. The airport builder can be tested via a link in the discord server.


This is a temporary solution. The goal is to make the airport builder a free DLC and that airports can be shared via the Steam Workshop.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Gaps removed between segments – Update Notes June 19th
notes.content:
When zoomed in there could sometimes be visible gaps between taxiway segments. These has now been taken care of. The loading time might increase slightly. I have also filled in the centre of some intersections.

Fixed a bug where voice stopped working due to setting the holding point or exit point for an airplane.

I will mainly focus on the airport layout builder for a while and hopefully I will be able to release it in a few weeks.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Improved visibility of one-way taxiways to beta – Update Notes June 10th
notes.content:
One-way taxiways are now indicated with white arrows. Some stands without pushback also have an arrow in cases it might be unclear which way the airplane should enter from.

New radar setting. Show the current set path for an airplane when cursor is over or when airplane is selected.

Backend changes for improved queue management in the pathfinding system.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Default Routes feature added to Beta - Update Notes June 3rd
notes.content:
Default routes can now be set at the airports. It can be used for arriving airplane to automatically start taxing a route or as a shortcut when giving taxi instructions. Can be found under Settings > Points and Routes.

The default entry and exit points have also been updated and now allows you to set your own defaults. It also now allows multiple points as defaults and airplane will try to exit on the side closest to their assigned stand if there are default exit points on both sides. The default points that come with the game has been changed so that there is at least one on each side of the runway at airports like RKSI Seoul.

Things have been moving forward at an unusually high speed over the past week, so multiple smaller things has been fixed as well:
- Added a delay between pushback stopping and requesting taxi to simulate removing the tug and ground crew getting clear of the aircraft.
- Small change that if the holding point for a departing aircraft is changed while the aircraft is already in an active delay event there is no further delay added.
- Fixed bug with incorrect taxi speed after pushback.
- Fixed incorrect taxiway name at RKSI.
- Fixed bug when deleting aircraft first in departure queue at runway.
- Fixed bug with handoff button not showing in some crossing situations.
- BAW (Speedbird) has been changed to CFE (Flyer) at EGLC to match real life operations.

notes.title: Update live again with fixes - Update Notes May 28th
notes.content: A new version of the update seems to be working well on the public beta and therefore the default version is also updated again. Of course if there are issues feel free to report them in the suggestions and bugs thread.

notes.title: Updates to radar, runways, and scoring for arrivals – Update Notes May 22nd
notes.content:
This update has been rolled back due to game breaking bugs. Thanks for letting me know as these bugs did not appear when testing the game in the game engine or via Steam.

I been working on the airport layout builder. All airports are now stored in text instead of separate scenes (which made the game install size smaller as a nice bonus). The builder itself will take more time and therefore I took a break from that to do other things that directly impact the gameplay.

The radar now has options for the icons of the airplanes (airplane, square or dot). Also, you can change the update rate and display radar trails to closer match real radar screens.

An airplane’s assigned runway can now be changed. Which can be especially useful when switching runway directions, just make sure to switch runway directions before trying to change the assigned runway (as you can only select runways in use). Also, runways and holding points can be changed during taxi however the pilots will request 2 to 4 minutes to prepare for the new departure.

The scoring for the arrivals has changed and the time displayed in the arrivals list is the slot time (landing time) and not arrival time at stand as before. Full points are rewarded if the airplane reach the stand within 5 minutes after the slot time. After 5 minutes the points start going down and 15 minutes after the slot time 0 points are rewarded. If the stand is not ready the time is changed (for example if stand needs 6 minutes the slot time is moved 6 minutes).

Lastly some smaller fixes:
- Fixed aircrafts blocking clicking waypoints during pathsetting.
- Cursor smoothing can now be toggled off or on.
- LIRF bug with runways 25 and 34R resolved.
- To reduce time to first arrival the first arrival lands 3 minutes after it has been added to the arrivals list instead of the normal 5 minutes.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix 13th May
notes.content: Fix airplanes not spawning in tutorial.

notes.title: Faster exits and some small fixes – Update notes 8th May
notes.content:
This update brings some smaller fixes. Mainly fixes to the layout of some airports. But there are some more notable changes.

- Airplanes using a high-speed exit will exit the runways at a slightly higher speed.

- Tugs can be sent to aircrafts on taxiways again (the button disappeared during a UI change).

I have also spent some time planning for the next step for the game and I think it would be nice to make an airport layout builder. This would allow you to create your own airports. This would require the way airports are stored to change and an interface to build layouts. Unfortunately, I do not have a time plan for this and it is still in early stages so please do not get too excited.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix Apr. 21st
notes.content: Small update to public beta to have error codes appear if there are issues with the connection to Steam.

notes.title: Adding the final 3 airports for V2.0 to beta – Update Notes Apr. 12th
notes.content:
With less than week left until the planned release of V2.0 the development is making good progress.

The final 3 airports are now added! It is KSEA Seattle, LIRF Rome and RJBB Osaka. High scores and achievements has been added for all new airports.

Something I noticed when playtesting KSEA is that the airplanes going back to ground frequency after each runway crossing can be a bit tedious. Therefore, this version tests a new rule that if the airplane has a path that crosses multiple runways or crosses one runway and ends at a holding point that it can take off from then the airplane stays on the tower frequency.

Also, some of these new airports fit better on screen when rotated. Therefore, the view save system has been reworked to include rotation and if there is a saved view in slot 1 then it loads that view on start. Note that this means that views in the old system are not valid anymore and cannot be loaded, sorry for the inconvenience.

And even more there are two new events. One for arrivals which is that the stand is not ready. While the stand is not ready it is not possible to set a path to the stand. The second one is rejected takeoff which can lead to a return to stand or time needed for preparations for a new takeoff.

Finally, some short notes:
-	Bloom / glow is available in settings again.
-	Changes to high score system. Old high scores should be transferred automatically.
-	Tutorial has been updated.
-	UI is still being worked on. In this beta version I have tested a more high contrast color scheme.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: A new cleaner UI and other changes – Update Notes 3rd Apr.
notes.content:
Thanks for the feedback on the last beta version. The UI has been reworked once more and has now a much more clean design which gives the radar view a lot of screen area. To make this possible some other information such as score and status had to be combined.

Also, I am trying a new concept for the instruction buttons (hold position, contact tower etc.). These now pop up when selecting an aircraft. Something you will probably notice is that to set a path you now have to press “taxi…”/”push and start approved…” before setting path. However, this is usually the option at the bottom of the list which can be quickly selected by pressing the aircraft one more time.

There was also feedback regarding selected entry and exit points from the runway. Departures can now enter the runway from any holding point. However, there is a penalty if it is not the selected entry for that aircraft.

There are some known issues with this beta. Tutorial not working, airplanes might get stuck on the runway when running the clock at highest speed and the auto status change is not working.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: 2 new airports in beta and some new procedures to test – Update Notes 18th Mar.
notes.content:
Thank you for your suggestions for the new airports. I am currently creating the new airports and 2 of them are now available in the beta version, KRSW Southwest Florida International Airport and ZSSS Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport. Note that high scores and achievements are not implemented for the new airports yet.

The beta also has a new start procedure for departing airplanes.
Airplanes that do not require pushback will now request start. Temporarily accepting this request is done using the same button and shortcut as send push (button says start instead of send push when you can approve engine start). A few minutes later the pilot will request taxi. Aircrafts that require pushback is the same as before.

All airplanes are now assigned an entry and exit point for their assigned runway. There is a default entry and exit for each runway however this can be changed before engine start for departures and before landing for arrivals. Arrivals now show up in the list 5 minutes before landing to allow time to select exit point.

Lastly, the radar view can now be rotated to make airports with runways in the south to north direction fit better on the screen. Also, views have been moved and reduced to 5 saved views. This was done for UI-layout reasons. If there is a demand for more than 5 saved views let me know.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New beta version and airport suggestions form is out – Update Notes 7th Mar.
notes.content:
A new beta version has been released. It contains the following:
- More voices. 10 voices in total which is most likely the final amount. There might be some tweaks to the voices in the future to try to get a more natural sound. However, a readback consists of multiple audio clips which limits how natural the sound gets. (The reason for multiple audio clips is to allow for various combinations of callsigns, runways, instructions and so on)

- Changed volume control steps

- UI redesign sort of. I have returned to a flat UI design aiming for a less cluttered feeling. If you have a screen with a 16:10 ratio the UI does not quite work in this beta version as some parts will overlap.

- Taxiway holding points markers (dashed line) has been removed. The reason being reduce number of objects on the screen and the game uses intersections as holding points and not specific holding points. In the real world some airports have specific holding points for taxiways, but at least for now this is disregarded in the game.

The suggestions form for the new airports is out. Send your suggestions here.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix - Tutorial not starting
notes.content: A hotfix to make the tutorial start.

notes.title: Airport specific airlines and improved camera controls – Update Notes 13th Feb.
notes.content:
The callsigns are now based on which airlines are active at the specific airport. The frequency of a callsign also varies. For example, Korean Air is active at both Seoul and Vancouver however it will be seen more often at Seoul than Vancouver.

Moreover, keyboard controls have been added for the camera. The key can be changed in the settings as well as the sensitivity (sensitivity effects both mouse and keyboard).

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Default moves to latest version – Update Notes 1st Feb.
notes.content:
The default version of the game has been updated to the latest version. While there are a few tweaks left to fix, it feels like the default version was far behind the beta. The current version does also feel a lot more stable than previous beta versions and has all the airports and a tutorial so therefore it will be the default version as well. (The public beta has also been moved to latest version so no needed to switch to default)

So, with this version the main changes are...
all current airports available.
window positions are saved between sessions.
notifications can be hidden (also saved between sessions).
functional tutorial with a new achievement for finishing it.

The tutorial is quite long as there is a lot of information to give to new players. If you have feedback on how to make it smaller or in other ways make it more enjoyable, please post in the suggestions thread.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: One more beta – Update Notes 22nd Jan.
notes.content:
The main version update has to wait a bit longer as this new beta introduces stands that do not use pushback. This can be seen at Vancouver and London City Airport. The work with the UI is moving forward. Hopefully next update will be for the main version.

- UI still in development.
- Vancouver added to beta.
- London City Airport redesigned to not use pushback (closer to real life operations).

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New beta version (v1.33) available – Update Notes 11th Jan.
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback on the beta! There is now a new version available which has the following changes:
- Fixed bugs related to pathfinding
- Removed reversing paths for taxi (still possible while aircraft being pushed, so send out push tug if needed)
- Helsinki added to beta (however not as tutorial)
- Bloom (glow) is now a range instead of toggle
- UI redesign (for example moveable windows, at the moment not saved between sessions)

Note that the UI redesign is still ongoing.
Work will begin on updating the Seoul and Vancouver to new path system and update the tutorial.

notes.title: Shortcuts, taxiway lines and holding point improvements – Update Notes 19th Dec.
notes.content:
As mentioned in the previous update the taxiway lines are now visible at all times. There are also some changes to the buttons and shortcuts has been added. The shortcuts can be changed in the settings (found in the main menu or via the to right menu in-game). Let me know what you think of these changes (either via discord or steam discussions).

Interactions between airplanes and between an airplane and a holding point has been improved.
Changes to waypoints to improve path setting to some stands.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Stand switch, extra time and returning to stand – Update Notes 3rd Dec.
notes.content:
A new update and this one bring disruptions/special events. These are:
Extra Time – The aircraft has to stand still for a few minutes for the pilots to do some tasks. Still possible to move the aircraft but the countdown will pause.
Return to Stand – The aircraft has to return to stand.
Stand Switch – After deboarding the aircraft has to be moved by tug to another stand.

This update also has a new waypoint set-up for the runways. This allows runways to be used for taxing. I have also taken care of bugs related to the runways. Let me know if the issues are still present.
The visibility of taxiway lines is something that have been mentioned by multiple people and is something I plan to take a look at next.

There is now a discord server available to chat about the game, send bugs and suggestions (the steam discussions post can still be used).
https://discord.gg/T94N7GWV 

Looking forward chatting with you!

notes.title: Send the tug - Update Notes 23th Nov.
notes.content:
With this update you can now send a tug to move an airplane. For example, if two airplanes are blocking each other on a taxiway. It takes a few minutes for the tug to arrive (I am working on a way to show the ETA). It is still possible to delete an aircraft via the menu (which has been fixed).

I have fixed bugs related to runways (arriving at runway for takeoff and crossing).
The hitboxes for the airplanes has been changed to reduce unnecessary stopping.
Undoing a path while it is searching has been fixed.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Less collision but maybe a bit more stopping - Update Notes 12th Nov.
notes.content:
This update has an updated collision concept, now aircraft stop for other aircraft no matter the direction (not only if there is a queue as it was before). There is still some work to do as an aircraft might stop when it is about to pass near another aircraft. In that case just instruct it to continue taxing.

There is now an interactive tutorial instead of a guide.

It is now possible to undo the last part of a path by right clicking, to completely cancel a path right click once more.

Those are the main points. There is also some smaller fixes such as waypoints at some airports.

notes.title: Handoffs for crossing and more - Update Notes 30th Oct.
notes.content:
Airplanes should now be handed over to tower to cross active runways.

New option to change runways and arrival rate during a session. Press the edit button in the top left corner and do not forget to confirm the changes.

This update also brings a new look to the UI, feel free to give your opinions on the redesign.

notes.title: Update Notes 22th Oct.
notes.content:
A small update to make UI work on 16:10 aspect ratio and a "quick" fix to the spawn rate issue. All randomness has been removed, I hope to bring it back and have the player able to decide how much the spawn rate should vary.

Also pushbacks can be cancelled and there is also some changes to the main menu. The settings from the latest session should now be set when returning to the main menu / starting the game.

notes.title: Update Notes 17th Oct.
notes.content:
An update to mainly address issues with the UI.

Includes:

 Restructured UI to work better with ultrawide monitors.
 Moved UI to bottom of screen. Note that the aircraft closest to departure/arrival is now at the bottom.
 Added close button to guide.
 There will always be at least one aircraft in the departure list at the start of the session.
